title: 星环仪 / Orbital reliquary
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party graph; MIT TiXL/GLM/Godot renderer and particle dependencies; outbound license pending

descriptions.zh-CN: 六重金属星环独立旋转，青蓝球核与金色卫星组成精密仪器。双色灯光塑造材质，音量控制主光，星尘和辉光衬托轮廓。
descriptions.en-US: Six independently rotating metallic rings surround a cyan core and golden satellites. Two lights shape the instrument, with audio-reactive key illumination.
